title: LoftUp: Learning a Coordinate-Based Feature Upsampler for Vision Foundation Models
mechanism: Coordinate-based cross-attention upsampler that combines the full-res image with low-res VFM features, trained on mask-based pseudo-GT features, to give sharp pixel-level features.
adaptation: Full-res path for ViT segmenters: upsample DINOv2 tokens from 1/14 to 512 px guided by the EL image, then dot with query embeddings; fine-tune the upsampler end to end on our cells since it was trained on RGB natural images.
min_experiment: Within the EoMT arm: conv refinement head vs LoftUp upsampler, 5-fold CV; metric crack relF1@2 and crack IoU; kill if LoftUp variant is below conv head on relF1@2 by any margin and not better on IoU by > 0.012.
evidence: R: outperforms prior upsamplers across dense tasks (abstract). Related arXiv 2508.21529 shows upsampled VFM features separate hairline cracks in battery micrographs with few labels. Code stated as github.com/andrehuang/loftup (not opened).
prior_overlap: none: super-resolution heads listed as open under Resolution.
